Ah! irrational hands marred your beauty.
Looting, plundering, the rich deposits,
Through wide vales and dales, without sympathy
Destroyed the treasures, laid up in their pits.
When eyes to see, through the window of years.
Cannot but shed the vast ocean of tears.
